column1: # Alchemy engine functions of the gui, insight, viewer, windowinput, datapump, audio and collision libraries,
# named from their bodies, strings, reflection and callers; the Alchemy 5.0 kit (archive.org item alchemy-kit_202309)
# is cited by file and symbol and is medium at most.

column5: <evidence>. tools/split.py reads the first three.

j stub to igInsightCore_UserRegister (0x236140), passed as the extra callback item of igInsightCore_Register; the <C>_GetMetaObjectFunction stub convention. Alternative: igInsightCore_RegisterCallback

128-byte igSmartPointer<T> destructor run with flag -1 on GetVTable stack instances; T = the InitFields child type at +8 of igInsightCore (_managerList) and igSerialScheduler (_managerList), both igInfoManagerOrderedList; precedent CoreNames igSmartPointer_<T>_Destruct

igSmartPointer<T> destructor run by igInsightCore_GetVTable on +36; igInsightCore_InitFields types _windowResizeReceiver (+36) igWindowResizeEventReceiver
igSmartPointer<T> destructor run by igInsightCore_GetVTable on +40; igInsightCore_InitFields types _messenger (+40) igMessenger
igSmartPointer<T> destructor run by igInsightCore_GetVTable on +44; igInsightCore_InitFields types _clearRenderer (+44) igClearRenderer

stores igSerialScheduler_GetMetaObjectFunction at +60 of the abstract igInsightScheduler's meta object; same body as igTimer_SetAbstractProxy

prints "USAGE: %s [option1 ...]", "-n number", "--help", "--nologo" then one entry per viewer option with its default: the kit's static print_usage in alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igCommandLine.cpp, whose DEFAULT_FIELD list (insight/DefaultFields.h) gives the same option strings and defaults
printf "%s on|off|true|false\n\t%s\n\tdefault: %s" with "true"/"false": igCommandLine::printOption(const char*,const char*,igBool), alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igCommandLine.cpp
printf "%s int\n\t%s\n\tdefault: %d": igCommandLine::printOption(...,igInt), kit igCommandLine.cpp
printf "%s float\n\t%s\n\tdefault: %f": igCommandLine::printOption(...,igFloat), kit igCommandLine.cpp
printf "%s <3-vector>...": igCommandLine::printOption(...,const igVec3f&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
printf "%s <4-vector>..." with components 0,1,3,2 as the kit's own: igCommandLine::printOption(...,const igVec4f&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
strcmp of args[index] with the option, index++ on a match: igCommandLine::getOption, kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then atoi: igCommandLine::getOptionInt, kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then atof into a double: igCommandLine::getOptionFloat, kit igCommandLine.cpp
option match with a following argument, returns it and steps index by two: igCommandLine::getOptionString, kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then interns the value into an igStringRef: igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igStringRef&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then "on"/"true" -> 1: igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igBool&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
j stub to igCommandLine_GetOptionInt: igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igInt&) returns getOptionInt, kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionFloat then double->float: igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igFloat&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then igConvertString with " < %f , %f , %f > ": igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igVec3f&), kit igCommandLine.cpp
getOptionString then igConvertString with " < %f , %f , %f , %f > ": igCommandLine::getDefaultValue(...,igVec4f&), kit igCommandLine.cpp

fills the option defaults of DefaultFields.h, creates the repeat-count igIntList and file igStringRefList, takes the shared igViewerDefaults (creating it) and parses its extraCommandLine: the kit's igCommandLine::igCommandLine() in alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igCommandLine.cpp

releases the shared viewer defaults, then the file list (+236), the repeat list (+232) and the extraCommandLine string; GameMain's App destructor in the unwind table: igCommandLine::~igCommandLine, kit igCommandLine.cpp
drops the shared viewer defaults' use count (+232) and deletes them at zero: igViewerDefaults::releaseInstance, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igInsight/igViewerDefaults.h
turns argc/argv into an igStringRefList and hands it to igCommandLine_Setup: igCommandLine::parse(igInt argc, igChar **argv), kit igCommandLine.cpp
called by igCommandLine_Construct with the shared defaults' extraCommandLine: igCommandLine::parse(igString line, igInt numToSkip), kit igCommandLine.cpp

'--help' prints usage and exits, every '--option' of DefaultFields.h is read and copied to the shared viewer defaults, '-n'/'--' end the scan, other '-x' are "Unrecognized option", then files with their '-n' counts: igCommandLine::setup, kit igCommandLine.cpp

appends the "Insight" plugin repository (folder "plugins" / "insight") to the object system's plugin helper; the registrar's extra callback: igInsightCore::userRegister, alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igInsightCore.cpp
Requested format:  then color/alpha/depth/stencil bits ("default" when negative) and a 1.0 aspect: igInsightCore::createRenderDestinationFormat(igViewerDefaults*), kit igInsightCore.cpp

creates the window and visual context from the viewer defaults ("Failed to create display. Aborting", "Actual format: ..."), sets the video mode and clear colour: igInsightCore::createWindow, kit igInsightCore.cpp
index of the manager in _managerList >= 0; igInsightCore_AddManager/RemoveManager test it: igInsightCore::isRegistered, kit igInsightCore.cpp
instantiates every concrete igInsightPlugin subclass and registers it: igInsightCore::registerAllPlugins, kit igInsightCore.cpp
appends the plugin to _plugins (+104) and calls its slot 21 with the core: igInsightCore::registerPlugin, kit igInsightCore.cpp
calls the plugin's slot 22 with the core and removes it from _plugins: igInsightCore::unregisterPlugin, kit igInsightCore.cpp
unregisters _plugins from last to first: igInsightCore::unregisterAllPlugins, kit igInsightCore.cpp
every manager's slot 26 (RemoveAllInfo), then empties _infoList and drops its storage: igInsightCore::removeAllInfos, kit igInsightCore.cpp
zeroes _frameTime/_currentTime, calls every manager's slot 23 (Start) and starts _timer: igInsightCore::begin, kit igInsightCore.cpp
stops _timer and calls every manager's slot 24 (Stop): igInsightCore::end, kit igInsightCore.cpp
creates the window when missing, takes its visual context, hands the window to the dispatcher and the context to every renderer: igInsightCore::initializeDrawing, kit igInsightCore.cpp
clears every renderer's visual context, then the attribute pool's unregister: igInsightCore::terminateDrawing, kit igInsightCore.cpp
timer reading -> _frameTime/_currentTime, _worldTime += frameTime*factor>>18, dispatcher then scheduler: igInsightCore::handleEvents, kit igInsightCore.cpp
skips on a context error, counts _frames, traverses every renderer, then beginDraw/draw/endDraw with _traversalTime and _outputTime from the timer: igInsightCore::drawFrame, kit igInsightCore.cpp
returns the filter of _defaultFilters whose _msgType (+8) is the type: igFilterMessageDispatcher::getFilter, alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igMessageDispatcher.cpp
getFilter, else a new igMessageFilter of that type appended to the filters: igFilterMessageDispatcher::getFilterOrCreate, kit igMessageDispatcher.cpp

forwards the message to _dispatcher's PostMessage slot; igWindowResizeEventReceiver posts its viewport message through it: igMessenger::postMessage, alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igMessenger.cpp

stores the DefaultFields.h defaults (show bbox, normals colours, hfov 45, planes 0.1/1000, 640x448, ...) then reads them from the registry: igViewerDefaults::igViewerDefaults, alchemy-kit_202309 sources/lib/insight/igViewerDefaults.cpp

finds the "INSIGHT" (else "Viewer") registry section and reads every option key (extraCommandLine, showBBox, ... allocateVisualContextInScratchPad) into the defaults: igViewerDefaults::loadFromRegistry, kit igViewerDefaults.cpp
igLongStack_Register's field-adder argument: replaces the inherited _data field by an igLongMetaField array element field (g_igLongStack_dataMetaField); the <C>_InitFields convention
igNonRefCountedObjectStack_Register's field-adder argument: replaces the inherited _data field; the <C>_InitFields convention
igMatrixStack_Register's field-adder argument: replaces the inherited _data field by an igMatrix44f element field; the <C>_InitFields convention
igRandomNumber_Register's field-adder argument; stores igMersenneTwisterRandomNumber_GetMetaObjectFunction at +60 of the abstract meta object; same body as igTimer_SetAbstractProxy
quantises every vec3 of the list to (v-base)*65535/range shorts: igCompressVec3fListRange, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igCompression.h
finds the components' minimum and range, then igCompressVec3fListRange: igCompressVec3fList, kit igUtils/igCompression.h
quantises every 4-component element to (v-base)*65535/range shorts: igCompressVec4fListRange, kit igUtils/igCompression.h
finds the components' minimum and range, then igCompressVec4fListRange: igCompressVec4fList, kit igUtils/igCompression.h

stores the object in _destObj, its field of that name in _destMeta and the class and field names in _destMetaClassName/_destMetaFieldName (reflected igDataPump +8..+20): igDataPump::setDestByFieldName, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igDataPump.h
retained store of the argument into _dpi (reflected igDataPump +24): igDataPump::setDataPumpInterface, kit igUtils/igDataPump.h
samples _dpi at the time, writes the value into _destObj through _destMeta when the types agree and runs the field's invariance function: igDataPump::update(igLong), kit igUtils/igDataPump.h
returns _dataPumpList (reflected igDataPumpInfo +20): igDataPumpInfo::getList, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igDataPumpInfo.h
appends the pump to _dataPumpList (+20) and returns 1: igDataPumpInfo::append(igDataPump*), kit igUtils/igDataPumpInfo.h
updates every pump of _dataPumpList (+8) with the time; igViewerDataPumpManager passes the core's _worldTime: igDataPumpManager::update(igLong), alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igDataPumpManager.h
appends every pump of a list to _dataPumpList (+8): igDataPumpManager::append(igDataPumpList*), kit igUtils/igDataPumpManager.h
igDataPumpManager_AppendList of the info's list; igViewerDataPumpManager calls it for every igDataPumpInfo: igDataPumpManager::append(igDataPumpInfo*), kit igUtils/igDataPumpManager.h

pushes a copy of the top matrix (the matrix itself on an empty stack) and pre-multiplies it: igMatrixStack::pushPreMultiply, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igMatrixStack.h (same order of the four methods)
pushes a copy of the top matrix and post-multiplies it (top = top * m): igMatrixStack::pushPostMultiply, kit igUtils/igMatrixStack.h
pre-multiplies the top matrix: igMatrixStack::preMultiply, kit igUtils/igMatrixStack.h
top = top * m: igMatrixStack::postMultiply, kit igUtils/igMatrixStack.h

MT19937 genrand step over _mt/_mti (624/397, 0x9908b0df tempering); the GetNumber slot only calls it: igMersenneTwisterRandomNumber::getNumberNonVirtual, alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igMersenneTwisterRandomNumber.h
sscanf with the format (3 values) or the flexible 3-float array conversion: igConvertString(igString, igVec3f&, " < %f , %f , %f > "), alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igUtils.h
sscanf with the format (4 values) or the flexible 4-float array conversion; called with " < %f , %f , %f , %f > ": igConvertString(igString, igVec4f&), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
formats three floats with the format and interns the text: igConvertToString(const igVec3f&, "<%f,%f,%f>"), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
formats four floats with the format and interns the text: igConvertToString(const igVec4f&, "<%f,%f,%f,%f>"), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
j stub to igRegistry_GetValueInt: igGetRegistryValue(igRegistry*, igInt, igString, igInt&, ...), alchemy-kit_202309 include/igUtils/igUtils.h
j stub to igRegistry_GetValueFloat: igGetRegistryValue(..., igFloat&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
j stub to igRegistry_GetValueStringObj: igGetRegistryValue(..., igStringObj*&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
j stub to igRegistry_GetValueString: igGetRegistryValue(..., igStringRef&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
j stub to igRegistry_GetValueBool: igGetRegistryValue(..., igBool&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
reads the key as a string (default from igConvertToString "<%f,%f,%f>") and converts it with " < %f , %f , %f > ": igGetRegistryValue(..., igVec3f&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
reads the key as a string (default "<%f,%f,%f,%f>") and converts it with " < %f , %f , %f , %f > ": igGetRegistryValue(..., igVec4f&, ...), kit igUtils/igUtils.h
